SECOND, AND THIS IS THE FAILURE, the composed supplemental pleading - a document the packet itself says on its face is filed with the petition, captioned IN THE CIRCUIT COURT OF ____ COUNTY, WEST VIRGINIA - recites its own controlling records' words, with the internal framing printed. Read off delivered pages 9 and 10: item 2 and item 3 each print the line 'From the packet record, in its own words:' followed by a verbatim participant instruction - 'Obtain Documentation of compliance ... Ask the programme provider for written documentation of your compliance, covering the dates you were in the programme, and ask them to confirm in writing that the programme is approved by the Secretary of the Department of Health' and 'Obtain Certificate of graduation ... Ask the course provider for your certificate of graduation'; item 4 prints 'Eligibility clock. The route record for this petition states it as follows:' and quotes it; the signature block prints 'Signature requirement, from the route record: "The petitioner signs the petition and the supplemental pleading, swears the verification before a notary public or other official ..."'; item 1 prints '(write TREATMENT, JOB READINESS, or BOTH - whichever describes what you are relying on. Only you know which)'; item 5 prints '(list what you are actually attaching, from the checklist in this packet)'; and the page closes 'This pleading was prepared from the petitioner's own details and from the packet record.' The 'Obtain ...' paragraphs are word-for-word the same strings the RECORDS CHECKLIST prints on delivered page 11, so the guide's own text is on the filing. This is the internal-record-text-printed-on-a-filing class in the Captain's DEFECTS_NO_COUNTER_CAN_SEE record, whose fix is stated as: filings recite statute citations and rule text only, and the record's own words belong in the guide, labelled as internal record text. But the framing that names the internal record on the face of a filing was not removed, and it is still a court filing that tells a circuit judge what 'the route record for this petition' and 'the packet record' say, and that instructs the petitioner to go and ask a provider for documents.

SELF_HELP_STOP.measured: This is the second failure and it is the more serious of the two. The committed legal-design-track-registry entry for wv_acc_treatment_job_readiness carries TEN selfHelpStopConditions. I checked each one against participant-instructions.md and against the full extracted text of all 14 delivered pages, normalised for dashes, quotes and the section sign. NINE of the ten appear in neither: 'Any felony conviction, which is a referral trigger on this route as on wv_conv_nonviolent_felony'; 'Any doubt whether the treatment or recovery programme is approved by the Secretary of the Department of Health, or the job readiness course by the West Virginia Department of Education'; 'Any violence, domestic violence, household member, strangulation, sex, child victim, deadly weapon, dwelling burglary or DUI issue'; 'Any CDL or commercial motor vehicle issue'; 'Any pending charge'; 'Any protection, no-contact, restitution or restraining order'; 'Any identified victim who may oppose, and any notice of opposition actually filed'; 'Any prior expungement, which likely exhausts the once-per-lifetime rule that this section shares with section 61-11-26'; and 'Firearm rights, immigration, professional licensing, law enforcement or corrections employment, or federal, tribal, military or out-of-state records questions'. The only one present is 'The court sets the matter for hearing', and it is present only incidentally, inside the single postGenerationHandoffs sentence. There is no stop section of any kind: the guide's twelve headings contain nothing like 'when to stop and get help', and the word 'lawyer' occurs once in the guide and once in the whole delivered packet, in the IF IT IS OPPOSED line on page 14. The first stop condition is the one that matters most here, because this packet ships SCA-C907, the FELONY petition, as one of its two conditional primary filings and tells the participant on page 13 to file it 'where the conviction to be expunged is a nonviolent felony' - while the family's own registry says any felony conviction is a referral trigger on this route. A participant with a felony is handed the felony petition and is never told that their own route record says that is the point to get a lawyer. Two further registry entries bear on the same gap and are also absent from every delivered page and from the guide: the scopeRestriction 'One open question first: whether a single misdemeanor qualifies under this section at all ... Do not ship the 90-day single-misdemeanor row until that is confirmed', and the releaseBlocker on how the section 61-11-26a(a)(1) ninety-day clock interacts with the section 61-11-26(b)(1) one-year clock. Both are undisclosed while delivered page 10 and the guide's own opening both state the clock as settled: 'ninety days of programme compliance OR completion of an approved job readiness adult training course ... the accelerated clock replaces the Sec. 61-11-26(b)(1) one-year wait for a single misdemeanour'.
